create_experiment_local_arg_printer: create an xmanager experiment that packages and runs a Bazel-built binary locally
run_local_bazel_binary: run a local xmanager job that packages a Bazel binary and executes it with environment variables
package_bazel_binary: package a Bazel binary as an xmanager Packageable with local executor specification
add_local_job: add an xmanager Job with a local executor and custom environment variables to an experiment
create_local_executor_spec: create a local executor specification for xmanager experiments using xm_local.Local.Spec
